execution.description: Repeated the Git Bash wrapper invocation with an explicit process-local Git safe-directory setting for the managed worktree.

expected: The safe-directory setting would let the wrapper prove that its path belongs to the Carbon repository root and launch the pinned container.

keep: Keep the canonical wrapper's exact root-identity check unchanged.
change: Stop local canonical retries on this host and require GitHub's pinned canonical lanes for delivery acceptance.
